newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on kerb market agitation.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on kerb market agitation.

text.p: Shares on Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are seen falling on Sunday as kerb market traders plan more agitations demanding measures to boost the market, brokers said.
"The punters want resumption of loans to share investors by state-owned Investment Corporation of Bangladesh and other measures to revive their confidence," said one broker.

"The investors have lost their confidence due to the persistent fall in share prices amid panic selling. The volume of the trade may be thin if the noisy agitation by kerb market traders continues today," said broker Mahbub Morshed.
The DSE benchmark index closed 48.8 points or 1.83 percent down at 2,618.3 on Saturday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
